ths.text: Heliod, the god of the sun, notices Elspeth after she kills a deadly hydra and makes her his champion, converting the blade she took into the spear Godsend.
She and Daxos then face the awakened hydra Polukranos, whom Elspeth defeats with Godsend.
After Elspeth defeats Xenagos in Nyx, Heliod fears her power, takes Godsend and stabs her, then orders Daxos to purge Meletis of the other gods, which starts a war of the gods.
Elspeth returns from the Underworld with the Shadowspear, and Heliod's spear shatters against it, so Erebos places him beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage home.

jou.text: Heliod, afraid of Elspeth's power, kills her with her own weapon.
After the Great Revel the gods blame mortals and swear vengeance against human civilization, and Elspeth flees into the wilderness, barely escaping Heliod's wrath.

thb.text: Heliod chooses Daxos, who rides a pegasus without saddle or reins, and makes him his Champion and a demigod to destroy signs of other divinities in Meletis.
The gods go to war and bring their champions to fight, while Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of his realm's souls.
Elspeth breaks free of the Underworld and defeats Heliod, who yields, and Erebos imprisons him there.
